issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hi, I recently setup IMAP for Gmail via the UI on 2023.2 and noticed everyonce in a while I get error messages in logs saying:

`Error doing job: Task was destroyed but it is pending!`

Then I enabled debugpy and found this:


```

    return _run_code(code, main_globals, None,

    exec(code, run_globals)

    return loop.run_until_complete(setup_and_run_hass(runtime_config))
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/asyncio/base_events.py", line 633, in run_until_complete
    self.run_forever()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/asyncio/base_events.py", line 600, in run_forever

    handle._run()

    self._context.run(self._callback, *self._args)
  File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/imap/coordinator.py", line 86, in async_wait_server_push
    idle: asyncio.Future = await self.imap_client.idle_start()
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/site-packages/aioimaplib/aioimaplib.py", line 746, in idle_start
    idle = asyncio.ensure_future(self.idle())
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.10/asyncio/tasks.py", line 615, in ensure_future

```

It calls for aioimaplib, but not sure if I properly classified this an an IMAP integration problem

It looks if the exception happens the future is never awaited.

hi just wondering if this has been fixed? I'm hesitant to enable the integration if not.

thank you @engrbm87

> hi just wondering if this has been fixed? I'm hesitant to enable the integration if not.
> 
> thank you @engrbm87 

I have the integration configured long ago and haven't got this error. I am not able to reproduce it.

thanks for your reply.

Yeah, I'm not sure either. I know there are a couple of other mentions that IMAP from the UI, slows things down significantly, then once disabled, it is fine.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/87827

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/87230

Hopefully something simple?

It looks like the task is fire and forget so if it hasn't finished by the time the next poll happens it makes a next one and they build up over time. It should get a timeout and track the previous task and avoid making a new one if it's still in flight

Thanks for clarification @bdraco. If the email server supports push (Gmail does) the coordinator will not have any update interval and will only run `async_update` once we receive a push from the server or after 29 minutes (which is the default timeout set by the library for waiting for a push). 
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/9df00bd285a656814c8073ad92e88d1778efdf25/homeassistant/components/imap/coordinator.py#L83 
The above method is responsible for the waiting and I can see that `idle` is awaited before we call a new update.
Having said that, is there any test that I can add to reproduce this?
I can reproduce the issue with my own IMAP server running debian and dovecot as IMAP mail server.
@jbouwh thanks for connecting and confirming. Hopefully a solution is possible, as it was nice to have (g)email in HA. Very useful integration.

The problem is in `async_wait_server_push`. May be it is a good idea to see if this is working without issues outside of HA.
May be this needs to be run in its own loop.
Besides the fact that it locks the HA startup I am seeing errors in my log.
That does not mean it is not working though.

I tracked this issue because `mqtt` didn't publish a birth message. Recently I added `imap` to work on some new features.
With this patch the HA setup is no longer held back.

review_comments: We need to check if a previous background task is running as well so we do not keep creating them each time the update happens.
The background task is started only once and is starting a new refresh. (The scheduler is disabled if support_push is enabled).
I'll dig a bit more. Something still feels like there is a chance of a race here where we can get multiple tasks or if the coordinator is called to refresh manually?

@bdraco your suspicions are valid. With IMAP enabled and updating to 2023.3.5, start up times are normal, however I am still seeing these task was destroyed pending messages in my log every once in a while. I'll have to confirm that with debugpy again, that they are indeed coming from IMAP but it was the only thing that I changed (enabling IMAP) other than updating to 2023.3.5

Jan fixed it in a larger refactor https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/89759

I haven't had a chance to test it yet though as I've been fighting with https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/89824 quite a bit more than I had hoped

Awesome! 

Making a Gmail account in honor of the PR, now that's priceless 😁
